name: Resolution-Tuned Cross-Attn
tagline: Pure cross-attention conditioning with 8 heads at large channel counts and 4 heads at small ones; no time-path coupling.

key_hyperparams.name: num_heads
key_hyperparams.role: more heads at higher capacity blocks

diff_from_baseline: Same cross-attention conditioning as the cross-attn baseline, but doubles head count from 4 to 8 in blocks with channels >= 128.

name: Self-Gated AdaLN-Zero + Time Add
tagline: AdaLN-Zero modulation gated by a per-channel sigmoid computed from the feature map itself, on top of a concat-FiLM time path.
formula:
$$\mathrm{emb} = \mathrm{temb} + c$$
$$y = \mathrm{AdaLN\text{-}Zero}(h, c)$$
$$g = \sigma\bigl(W_g\,\mathrm{GAP}(h)\bigr) \in [0,1]^{B\times C\times 1\times 1}$$
$$h' = h + g \odot (y - h)$$

key_hyperparams.name: self_gate conv
key_hyperparams.role: per-channel gate on AdaLN delta; sigmoid(0)=0.5 at start

init_recovers: concat-FiLM at init (AdaLN gate is zero)
diff_from_baseline: Combines concat-FiLM time injection with AdaNorm baseline, then multiplies the AdaLN residual delta by an additional spatial-pooled feature-derived sigmoid gate (data-dependent on h, not just the class embedding).

name: GroupNorm FiLM + Zero Conv
tagline: Per-block GN + FiLM (scale/shift from class) followed by SiLU and a zero-initialized 1x1 conv residual; no time-path coupling.
formula:
$$\mathrm{emb} = \mathrm{temb}$$
$$[\gamma,\beta] = W\,\mathrm{SiLU}(c),\quad x = (1+\gamma)\odot \mathrm{GN}(h) + \beta$$
$$h' = h + W_{\text{out}}\,\mathrm{SiLU}(x),\ \ W_{\text{out}}\text{ zero-init}$$
diff_from_baseline: Like AdaNorm baseline but uses GroupNorm(32) instead of GroupNorm(1), drops the per-block gate path, and adds an explicit SiLU + zero-init 1x1 conv residual after FiLM modulation.

name: Orthogonal Class Add + AdaLN-Zero
tagline: Time path receives only the class component orthogonal to time_emb (scaled by 0.35); spatial path uses AdaLN-Zero modulation.
formula:
$$\hat{t} = \frac{t}{\Vert t\Vert+\epsilon},\quad c_\perp = c - (c\cdot \hat{t})\,\hat{t}$$
$$\mathrm{emb} = t + 0.35\,\frac{c_\perp}{\Vert c_\perp\Vert+\epsilon}$$
$$[\gamma,\beta,g] = W_p\,\mathrm{SiLU}(c),\ \ \hat{h} = (1+\gamma)\,\mathrm{GN}(h) + \beta$$
$$h' = h + g\odot(\hat{h} - h)$$

key_hyperparams.name: alpha
key_hyperparams.role: scale on the orthogonal class direction added to temb

init_recovers: AdaLN-Zero at init for the spatial path
diff_from_baseline: Hybrid of concat-FiLM and adanorm baselines: instead of plain emb=t+c, projects class emb onto the unit-vector orthogonal to t, normalizes, scales by 0.35, then adds; the spatial conditioner is exactly AdaLN-Zero.

name: Concat-FiLM + Cross-Attn (Hybrid)
tagline: Adds class to time embedding (concat-FiLM) and additionally cross-attends features to class as key/value after every block.
diff_from_baseline: Strict superposition of two baselines: concat-FiLM in the time path AND cross-attn in every spatial block. Identical per-block components to those baselines, just stacked.
